text: Welcome to Voice Studio. If you're thinking, great, another transcription app... check this out.
Pick a saved voice. Give it a script. Build a conversation, one speaker at a time. The voice you're hearing right now? We made it in the app you're watching.
Take that audio and turn it back into editable text. Clean up a recording, trim the take, and keep the original. Even describe a brand-new voice and make it speak.
Drop your clips onto the timeline. Move them around, save the session, and export the mix.
No. Probably not. We did it anyway.
And you thought your faceless AI channel was easy before.
Now we took it one step further. So you don't really have an excuse to keep making lazy shit.
Voice Studio. Over-engineered anti-AI-slop generation. Probably.
